taskPacket.objective: A failing command proof with oversized output can no longer crash the controller mid-gate, a Python virtual environment no longer moves the ignore-source fingerprint, and the contract reference states what a gate costs and what it will not see.
instructions: boundedText (scripts/judge-gate.mjs) reserves the ellipsis marker's 3 bytes and shrinks until the encoded result fits, so a finding's evidence never exceeds the 4 KiB ceiling even when the cut lands inside a multibyte character.
captureIgnoreSources (scripts/verification.mjs) skips a virtual environment like node_modules: .venv and venv by name, and any directory holding pyvenv.cfg.

references/contract.md gains a section stating three gate properties: a command proof is executed at gate time under a 120-second cap; failOn ['critical'] is close to no gate at all against a judge that works at major; a worker reads only inside its worktree, so text a node must read belongs in the packet.
verification tests pin the oversized failing proof accepted by validateNodeSnapshot and the venv-neutral fingerprint.
nonGoals: Changing the 4 KiB evidence ceiling or the validator that enforces it.
